text:
Renee Park: FYI folks  small but important clarification to parental leave travel & companion reimbursement policy going live 2026-07-01. Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/parental-travel-companion (TL;DR below)

Owen Li: Quick question 1) who is eligible to bring a travel companion under this policy?

Renee Park: Eligible: employees on active Parental Leave (paid or unpaid) and employees returning from Parental Leave within 30 days. Companion = partner, parent, or licensed caregiver who must travel with the employee or child for medical/immigration reasons. Must be pre-approved.

Lina Gomez: What exactly is covered? Hotel nights for the companion, companion airfare, and short-term caregiver stipend?

Renee Park: Yes, up to per-trip caps: companion airfare up to $800, companion hotel up to $150/night for max 7 nights, or a caregiver stipend of $120/day for up to 7 days if companion is providing in-room care. Combined per-trip cap $1,200. Annual aggregate cap $2,500 per employee.

Samir (Legal): A few legal notes: 1) Visa/immigration fees for dependents or companions are not routinely covered, exceptions require senior People Ops sign-off. 2) For US payroll: reimbursements tied to parental leave travel may be taxable depending on amount and reason; Payroll will mark items for tax review. 3) Documentation: manager approval + brief justification required, do not upload medical records into expense systems.

Priya Nair: Submission process: use Concur -> Expenses -> New -> PARENT-TRAV. Attach receipts and a one-line justification (e.g., "partner airfare for newborn passport appointment, 2026-07-15"). People Ops aims for 5 business day turnaround on routine claims.

Owen Li: Is this retroactive to recent trips? I had to bring my partner on a trip in June for passport processing.

Renee Park: Retroactivity: exceptions possible for trips between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30 if you file by 2026-07-15 and include manager confirmation. Outside that window well consider only mission-critical exceptions.

Lina Gomez: Are contractors eligible?

Renee Park: No1) standard contractors and temporary staff excluded. 2) Long-term vendors or contractors embedded full-time can request an exception by emailing people-ops@redwood.com with the engagement details.

Samir (Legal): International claim guidance: receipts in local currency are fine; include a conversion method (bank statement or currency tool screenshot). Some countries treat these reimbursements differently for tax; include your country in the note.

Priya Nair: Managers: youll see PARENT-TRAV items as a separate ledger line and they wont reduce team travel budgets. Please approve only when the trip is legitimately tied to parental leave logistics or dependents.
